challengeFindings.title: A resumed build whose plan edits (task ticks, appended challenge tasks, logs) touch lines `dev` also changed loses the whole commit's edits to that file, non-overlapping hunks included, and `branches rebase` exits 0

When a plan file is settled on the target's copy and that empties the commit, the rebase log says the commit's changes "were already on the target", although the branch's differing version was thrown away

A plan log named with a glob character (`n*.md`) that dev deleted makes `bkit branches rebase` run `git rm` on it as a pattern, silently deleting the feature's other tracked logs (`notes.md`, `next-steps.md`, and with `*` also `status.jsonl`) while reporting `resolved` for that one path and exit 0

A branch named `feat/logs/995-y/x` or `feat/archive/{stamp}-{other-fid}` makes `rebasedFid` return a feature id holding `/`, so `bkit branches rebase` auto-resolves a file inside another feature's folder (`docs/plans/202611/logs/995-y/x-plan.md`) or another feature's archived plan (`docs/plans/202611/archive/{stamp}-{other-fid}-plan.md`) instead of refusing it

tests.testName: does not silently drop a later branch edit to the plan file when dev changed an adjacent line

challengeFindings.title: A full disk or a blocked outbox folder makes keeping the branch's plan-log copy throw, so `bkit branches rebase` crashes with exit 1 and leaves the rebase in progress and half resolved, with no abort, no sentinel and no JSON, instead of refusing

The test for a branch that ends on the target's exact plan-log bytes builds its commits with `commit()`, which appends, so the branch ends on `v1\ndev copy\n`, the test repeats the differing two-round case, and the byte-identical case that empties its commit is never run

A plan-log conflict whose branch copy differs makes `bkit branches rebase` write the absolute outbox path (`/Users/{name}/.../.git/bkit-outbox/{FID}/dropped-logs/...`) into `{LOG_DIR}/rebase-resolve-log.md`, a tracked plan log the build commits and ship lands on public `dev`, so the operator's OS user name and checkout layout enter permanent git history

tests.testName: names the kept branch copy in the rebase log by an outbox-relative path, never an absolute one
